# `passportsim ble_scan`

Scan the virtual air with the scripted BLE central.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `radio` |
| MCP tool | `passport_ble_scan` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/ble_scan` |
| Scenario step | `ble.scan` |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `advances_time`, `needs_instance` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim ble_scan [duration_ms] [--fresh] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--timeout-ms <TIMEOUT_MS>] [--wall-budget-ms <WALL_BUDGET_MS>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `duration_ms` | `<duration_ms>` | `integer` | no | How long the central scans, in milliseconds of virtual time; 0 scans nothing and reports the radio's state. |
| `fresh` | `--fresh` | `boolean` | no | Report only the advertisers this scan added, not every one the central knows. |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `timeout_ms` | `--timeout-ms <TIMEOUT_MS>` | `integer` | no | Virtual time this call may spend before E_TIMEOUT. |
| `wall_budget_ms` | `--wall-budget-ms <WALL_BUDGET_MS>` | `integer` | no | Host time this call may spend before E_WALL_BUDGET. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/ble_scan.input.json`](../schema/commands/ble_scan.input.json).

## Examples

### Listen for two seconds and list what advertises

```sh
passportsim ble_scan --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "duration_ms": 2000
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "duration_ms": 2000
}
'@ | passportsim ble_scan --json -
```

### Report the radio's state without scanning or advancing time

```sh
passportsim ble_scan --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "duration_ms": 0
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "duration_ms": 0
}
'@ | passportsim ble_scan --json -
```

### A short sweep reporting only what it newly heard

```sh
passportsim ble_scan --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "duration_ms": 200,
  "fresh": true
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "duration_ms": 200,
  "fresh": true
}
'@ | passportsim ble_scan --json -
```
